Two documentation issues surfaced while updating the installed pm-changelog copy in homeassistant-cli PR104. Fix these in the canonical pm-changelog source rather than patching each consumer's installed copy.

1. `docs/usage.md` links `pmc-3jq8` and `pmc-j6cb` through `../.agents/pm/issues/...`. These are valid in this source repository but become broken when the document is installed under a consumer's `.agents/pm/extensions/pm-changelog/docs/`. Both IDs belong to this repository, not the consumer's tracker. Use verified absolute GitHub links (or a published-doc mechanism that preserves their actual target).
2. The options table contains an unescaped pipe inside the inline example `<type>(deps|deps-dev): bump …`. Standard GFM table parsing treats it as an additional cell. Rewrite as separate deps/deps-dev examples or escape the pipe.

Acceptance: both tracker links resolve to the canonical pm-changelog items from source and installed documentation, and the `--dependency-updates` row retains exactly the declared three columns. No runtime change is needed.

Source: [usage documentation](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-changelog/blob/main/docs/usage.md). Review evidence: [link finding](https://github.com/unbraind/homeassistant-cli/pull/104#discussion_r4173841980), [table finding](https://github.com/unbraind/homeassistant-cli/pull/104#discussion_r4173841985). The suggestion to use the consumer's tracker was rejected because those item IDs are upstream-owned.
Keep installed usage documentation links portable and dependency table valid
